decisions.reason: Q2 contains 'increase' and Q1 'rise', which duplicate 'increase' in the answer label '200% increase'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Ask for the size of the change without increase/rise wording, e.g. 'What was the revenue change, as a percentage, for Millbrook businesses attributed to the Bowling Cart Challenge?'

decisions.reason: Q1 'held each year' and Q2 'recurring event' are near-synonyms of 'annual', leaking the label 'annual tradition'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword, e.g. 'What kind of tradition status did the Bowling Cart Challenge attain in Millbrook after 1962?' without each year/recurring/annual.

decisions.reason: Q2 'a motorized activity and a bowling game' leaks both halves of the label 'go-karting and bowling'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q2, e.g. 'What two sports did Timothy Abbott's 1961 Millbrook inaugural event combine?'

decisions.reason: Q1 contains 'mounted' (a label word) and Q2 says 'described in the source' (not closed-book).
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword closed-book without mounted, e.g. 'What was affixed to the go-karts in the Millbrook Bowling Cart Challenge?' and drop the 'source' reference from Q2.

decisions.reason: Q1 says 'according to the source', which is not closed-book wording; Q2 'precision motor skills' hints 'driving'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q1 closed-book, e.g. 'What two skills does the Millbrook Bowling Cart Challenge combine?'

decisions.reason: Q2 contains 'economy' and 'boom' (near-synonym of 'boosted'), leaking the label 'boosted economy'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword Q2, e.g. 'What was the outcome for Millbrook's finances from the Bowling Cart Challenge's tourism and business activity?' without economy/boost/boom.
